concepts.title: Science Begins with Curiosity
concepts.definition: Science grows from the questions children naturally ask about their surroundings; the subject called Science organises this curiosity into careful observation, questioning and testing.
concepts.key_idea: Curiosity is the raw material of science: every 'why' is the first step of an investigation.
question_patterns: why is science said to begin with curiosity
what kinds of questions does science ask
how is science different from guessing
what did you explore in the preparatory stage
why do we observe our surroundings carefully
what makes a question a scientific question

concepts.title: The Scientific Method
concepts.definition: The method of science runs step by step: observe something, ask a question, guess a possible answer, test the guess with an activity, and draw a conclusion that others can check.
concepts.formula: method = observe + question + guess + test + conclude
concepts.key_idea: A test decides between guesses: the answer that survives checking becomes scientific knowledge.
question_patterns: list the steps of the scientific method
why do scientists test their guesses
what is a hypothesis in simple words
why should a conclusion be checkable by others
what do we do after an experiment fails
how does an activity settle a question

solution_steps.explain: Write out the parts, kinds or steps involved.

concepts.title: Science in Everyday Life: The Bicycle
concepts.definition: Even repairing a bicycle uses scientific thinking: observe what is wrong, guess the cause of the noise or the flat tyre, try the fix, and see if it works, exactly like a scientist at work.
concepts.key_idea: Everyday fixing and scientific research share one method: trial, observation, conclusion.
question_patterns: how is repairing a bicycle like doing science
what steps would you follow to find why a cycle squeaks
give one example of science at work in your home
how does a guess help in repairing things
why do we test only one change at a time
where else do you use the scientific method unknowingly

concepts.title: The Journey through Grade 6 Science
concepts.definition: The chapter previews the middle-stage journey: the diversity of life, food and health, magnets, measurement, materials, temperature, water, separation methods, living creatures, nature's treasures and the sky beyond earth.
concepts.key_idea: Science threads every theme together: one habit of careful questioning unlocks each new world.

which chapter of this book interests you the most and why
how are the themes of the book connected
why is science called a wonderful world
what skills will you gain by studying science
how does science connect different subjects
